profile.summary: EDesignC, Inc. is an engineering design firm that provides mechanical, electrical and plumbing design services. It specializes in energy, electrical and building system design. Its projects include schools, community buildings, government facilities, commercial buildings and affordable housing. It has offices in San Francisco, Oakland and Pleasant Hill, California.

review.notes: EDesignC, Inc. has an Oakland office and does electrical/MEP engineering design for schools, which fits the OUSD electrical upgrade design agreement; the legal name differs from the agenda only by a hyphen. I fetched both cited pages and they support every populated field. The summary is neutral. The site does not mention OUSD, so the match rests on name, city and service.
